packageRules.description: Base images of validator/Dockerfile: automerge digest and patch updates once CI passes (e.g. JRE security fixes)
Validator versions change validation results and behavior (e.g. SSRF protection in 6.10): always a reviewed PR
Our own image tag in docker-compose.yml is bumped by the release process, not by Renovate
